SELECT DISTINCT
u.page_id,
u.workspace, 
u.database_name,
u.title,
u.created_time
FROM unified_content u 
WHERE (
    u.database_name = 'journal'
    AND (
        LOWER(u.title) LIKE '%graham%'
        OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM generic_content g
            WHERE g.page_id = u.page_id
            AND (
                LOWER(g.title) LIKE '%graham%'
                OR LOWER(g.metadata) LIKE '%graham%'
            )
        )
    )
)
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 5000;
